body: It is a great time to begin my 2014 book We Make the Road by Walking . The book was written to be read in sync with the church year. Season 3 begins with Lent (which starts today) and this 13-week quarter, called Alive in a Global Uprising, is an immersion in the Sermon on the Mount. (It begins on page 127.) It was one of my favorite parts of the book to write – You can read the book on your own, or invite a few friends to read it with you. (You’ll find lots of reading group resources here .)
